title: Values Computation Note: Interest Credited on Whole Life Insurance Dividend Accumulations for a Closed Policy Year
content:
**Whole Life Insurance — dividend accumulations at interest.**

**Computation.** The interest credited for a closed policy year is the dividend accumulation balance shown on the policy multiplied by the tier's dividend accumulation rate, rounded half up to the cent. The credit is dated the anniversary that closes the policy year.

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Dividend accumulation balance | The policy record |
| Dividend accumulation rate | The tier's declared annual accumulation rate |
| Anniversary closing the year | The anniversary the policy's posted cash values are as of |

**Worked figures (hypothetical).**

| Tier | Balance shown | Rate | Interest credited |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove 10-Pay Whole Life | 18000.00 | 3.75% | 675.00 |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65 | 4321.17 | 3.75% | 162.0439, rounded to 162.04 |
| Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life | 0.00 | 0% | 0.00 (non-participating) |

The whole year's rate applies to the balance shown; the computation does not prorate by days.
